topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well now, who'd have thought it? Old Tom, always goin’ about in his patched coat and worn boots, turns out to have a chest as full as the church’s on Saint Stephen's Day. Heard the tale from Bill at the mill; said Tom’s been buying up land and gold while we all thought he was scrimp and save just to eat. Shows what we know, doesn’t it? I reckon there’s a lesson in this, though. Keep your own counsel and tend your field well, and the harvest will come. Maybe there’s more to the poor sod than meets the eye. Folks around here might start thinkin’ twice before they judge a man by his wagon.
